release_sync.active_call_policy: defer until call surface is closed
release_sync.reload_policy: at most one reload attempt per target version per browser session
release_sync.offline_policy: continue current shell and converge immediately after connectivity returns
release_sync.service_worker_policy: versioned cache; navigation/code network-first; release manifest never served from runtime cache
release_sync.privacy: release audit excludes precise location, IP address and message/media content

roles.OWNER: USER capabilities plus administrative Command Center

localStorage.vc_owner_persistent_v1: persistent OWNER authorization on this browser/device
localStorage.vc_stickers_custom_v1: small custom sticker payloads for pilot
localStorage.vc_release_audit_v1: bounded privacy-safe release and synchronization audit

sessionStorage.vc_release_reload_once:<version>: anti-loop guard allowing at most one automatic reload attempt for a target release

persistence.rule: Never remove or rename a persisted key without an explicit idempotent migration.

implemented_pilot: single unified USER and OWNER PWA
VCM invite generation and fragment prefill
persistent OWNER device authorization until explicit logout
OWNER contacts and personal communication workspace
location sharing by explicit user gesture
file/photo sharing through supported device Web Share
hybrid static and animated sticker picker
sticker recents favorites packs search and custom import

stickers.migration_rule: Preserve logical sticker IDs and user recents/favorites. Move custom binary payloads to encrypted object storage when backend is introduced.

video.migration_rule: Replacing the SFU/provider must preserve the in-app full-screen call surface and VIVA CUBA routes.

security_invariants: identity must not depend on phone SIM email or a single device
never represent local pilot controls as authoritative backend security
location requires an explicit user action
do not log raw invitation or recovery secrets unnecessarily
release audit must not contain precise location IP or message/media content
automatic update may perform at most one reload attempt per target version until the client version converges
application code must prefer network-first update semantics with offline cache fallback
migration_invariants: preserve USER and OWNER role semantics
preserve sticker recents favorites and custom assets
preserve conversation and attachment history once backend exists
preserve audit records required by policy
preserve release manifest and client convergence semantics
preserve public route compatibility or provide redirects
validate Spain Cuba and a normal international network
perform physical Cuba connectivity gate before declaring migration complete
maintain rollback until post-migration gates are GREEN
change_control: Any change to visible behavior, roles, persistence, routes, security requirements, providers, release semantics or migration semantics must update the MASTER SPEC and this contract in the same change.
